_meta_itemized.notes: A NIL REPORT filed as a cover sheet only: Roger L. Armstrong, County Council Seat A, Democrat, signed and dated 'September 23, 2016' (a typed, fully-written date, not the handwritten form most of this corpus uses). Every money cell that is filled reads a typed '$0' - a real numeral, not a dash or a slashed zero, so the zero-glyph ruling is not engaged here; the cover cache already carries them verbatim. The Last Report column is blank on all four rows (empty, not zero) and the module's stated-total layer correctly promotes 0 from the cumulative cells. Because he reported no money, there is nothing for a schedule page to itemize and the county published none - the absence of pages 2-3 is coherent with the cover, not a lost page. No street address or PO box was written into this record.
